direction: D13 bounded residual feedback patch over an exact Base prefix
evidenceRole: A fresh, precommitted development-validation-test method-validation experiment on a public LongMemEval-V2 subset that remained unread by D12. It is not a final programming-agent claim.

feedbackAdaptation.borrowedPrinciple: Store and retrieve bounded corrective evidence at inference time so feedback can affect related future queries without retraining.
feedbackAdaptation.scopeDifference: D13 reuses a bounded local-progress table and same-trajectory public evidence. It does not use synthetic feedback as evaluation truth or claim PatchRAG's QA results.

conformalPolicyControl.borrowedPrinciple: Treat an established Base path as a reference policy and explicitly limit candidate deviation.
conformalPolicyControl.scopeDifference: The byte-identical Base prefix and token certificates are engineering constraints, not calibrated likelihood-ratio control; no CPC guarantee is claimed.

conformalContextEngineering.borrowedPrinciple: Choose the smallest context budget on a held-out design boundary and report the coverage-quality-cost trade-off.
conformalContextEngineering.scopeDifference: The correction evidence is too small and non-exchangeable for a formal conformal-coverage claim, so D13 uses empirical phase gates and paired bootstrap intervals only.

consumedDesignDecision.boundary: The 84-configuration search consumed D12 development only. No D13 phase score was read before this protocol was frozen.

population.source: The exact union of D12 validation and D12 test; D12 development is excluded.

split.readOrder: Freeze protocol and harness; run development Base then candidate; run validation only after a committed development admission; run test only after committed development and validation admissions.

baseline.engine: MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 through executeConversationSearch
baseline.queryTransform: Remove final-answer formatting instructions only; retain the substantive question and options.

candidate.selectionRule: Route with the frozen bounded procedure and feedback sidecar. Among existing Base Top-40 candidates owned by that trajectory but absent from Base, select one by descending novel semantic spans, descending query coverage, ascending patch tokens, ascending FTS rank, then stable id.
candidate.patchRule: Greedily retain at most four verbatim semantic spans within 48 cl100k tokens, prioritize observable query overlap, render in source order, and append one provenance-bearing patch after every byte-identical Base item.
candidate.baseCertificate: Every Base item id, content, token count, and order is a byte-identical prefix of the candidate context.
candidate.patchCertificate: Every selected semantic span is verbatim and source ordered; the patch names the raw-memory id from which it came.
candidate.ordinaryNoop: No eligible route, candidate, novel span, or fitting patch returns exact Base and is not an operational fallback.
candidate.hardFallback: Disabled, missing procedure index, missing or overflowed feedback, missing raw pool, timeout, corruption, budget overflow, or certificate failure returns exact Base.

localFeedback.source: The frozen bounded local-progress table derived from normalized pre/action/post transitions.
localFeedback.verifiedArm: Wilson-rank coherent procedure trajectories and retain only locally verified actions before patch authorization.
localFeedback.agnosticAblation: Use FTS-ranked coherent trajectories and all bounded actions; patch ranking, budget, certificates, and fallback remain identical.
localFeedback.claimGate: Feedback may be credited only if contexts change, direct quality is noninferior with zero harms versus the agnostic arm, and mean tokens do not increase.
localFeedback.evolutionBoundary: Only the bounded transition-feedback table, coherent trajectory choice, verified action subset, and one-item residual organization evolve. FTS5, embeddings, raw indexing, extraction model, questions, answers, and Base remain unchanged.

forbiddenRuntimeInputs: development, validation, or test phase labels

directMetric.definition: Lower-case, normalize hyphens, punctuation, and whitespace, split phrase-set references by frozen evaluator separators, and measure exact whole-atom occurrence in injected memory. English action counts match only the explicit Observed source action count field.
directMetric.orderedSecondary: For ordered phrase questions, all normalized atoms must occur in reference order within one delivered memory unit.
directMetric.scopeWarning: Appending Base makes the primary support proxy mechanically nondecreasing. This phase tests bounded evidence reachability and implementation safety, not answer quality.

aggregation.bootstrap: paired stratified question bootstrap by domain

phaseAdmission.development: Every direct phase-gate check and independent validation must pass before validation Base is read.
phaseAdmission.validation: Every direct phase-gate check and independent validation must pass before test Base is read.
phaseAdmission.test: A direct test pass changes status only to pending_answer_level and permits the frozen answer-level panel.
phaseAdmission.failure: A failed phase rejects D13 under this protocol. Any follow-up must use a new protocol and cannot recycle unread later phases as design data.

answerLevelPanel.transport: Call the configured MiniMax and DeepSeek provider endpoints directly.
answerLevelPanel.pairedNoopRule: When candidate context is byte-identical to Base, reuse the same reader output for both arms so decoding noise cannot create a false effect.
answerLevelPanel.primaryCrossedJudges: DeepSeek judges MiniMax answers and MiniMax judges DeepSeek answers.
answerLevelPanel.claimRule: Only a full answer-level pass may support an answer-quality claim. A direct-only pass must be reported as pending answer-level evidence.

portability.datasetAdapter: LongTaskDatasetAdapter supplies questions, trajectories, and provenance. An internal programming adapter supplies the same neutral interfaces.
portability.evidenceAdapter: SourceEvidenceAdapter exposes bounded semantic values. A programming adapter may expose diagnostics, test failures, diff hunks, file or symbol names, configuration values, and constraints.
portability.unchangedLogic: Trajectory ownership, novelty ranking, one-item capacity, Base-prefix and provenance certificates, switches, logs, phase gates, and hard fallback are schema-independent.

selfOptimization.selectionRule: Choose the smallest token budget on the best eligible quality plateau, then fewer spans and stable policy id.
selfOptimization.postFreezeChangesAllowed: Bug fixes that preserve exact decisions on frozen design artifacts; any decision-changing change requires a protocol version bump and fresh baselines.
selfOptimization.claimBoundary: Development is selection evidence, validation is replication evidence, and test plus answer-level panel is confirmation evidence.
